name: Kal'Kravos Rexor
source:
Kal'Kravos Rexor is one of the lead desk anchors for the Galactic News Network. A seasoned veteran, he had a prestigious role with the Celestial News Corps, which he was terminated from under mysterious circumstances. Rumors are that he might have been a little too free with the secretary pool.

[In game description]
